definitions.explanation: Damage to physical property such as vehicles, buildings, or objects, as opposed to personal injury. Commonly used in insurance, legal, and accident contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧{物損|ぶっそん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately, it was only property damage.

examples.japanese: {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In the case of a property damage accident, reporting to the police is required.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{物損|ぶっそん}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数億円|すうおくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もられている→見積もる：14132_mitsumoru⟧。
examples.english: Property damage from the typhoon is estimated to amount to several hundred million yen.

notes:
Abbreviation of {物的|ぶってき}⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧ (material damage). Contrasts with {人損|じんそん} or {人身|じんしん} (personal injury). Essential vocabulary for understanding traffic accident reports and insurance documents.

USAGE:
Most frequently encountered in the compound {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (property damage accident), which refers to a traffic accident where only vehicles or objects are damaged and no one is injured. This distinction matters for insurance claims and police reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: property damage accident (no injuries)
- {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: property damage losses
- {物損|ぶっそん}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧: property damage only
- {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treated as property damage
- {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧: property damage claim

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人身|じんしん}{事故|じこ}→人身事故：08475_jinshinjiko⟧: personal injury accident — an accident involving bodily harm, contrasted with {物損|ぶっそん}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧: damage; loss — the broader term for any kind of damage or loss
- ⟦{破損|はそん}→破損：13679_hason⟧: breakage; damage — focuses on the physical breaking of an object rather than the legal/insurance concept
